checks: The pre-cutover archive and role export restore into a separate cluster and match all 20 tables.
The restored pre-cutover fixture reproduces browser access to private answers, messages and transcripts.
The complete ordered cutover runs on the restored copy and preserves every pre-cutover row in its original columns.

The ordinary app can post as another member. Only an owner processing the exact request can erase, and linked evidence needs separate approval.
Changed evidence, a new dependency or an inactive post or report guard invalidates the reviewed scope.
A forced late receipt failure rolls back post, moderation, AI consent and temporary authorization changes.
A new report waits on the independent erasure transaction, then cannot recreate a copy after commit.
The archive preserves other replies and the legacy salon. It keeps a neutral withdrawn anchor, clears linked text and rejects stale review while preserving the spent AI attempt.
A separate restore keeps the scrubbed thread, exact owner retry and private status receipt. Both report paths still refuse writes by the frozen account.

scope: Disposable PostgreSQL 17 with independent connections, the current Circle RPCs and a separate restore. Processing freezes new member-bound report and receipt writes. Previous report data stays available for review. Hosted rollout and the remaining erasure and retention decisions are open.
